cohort: Women who gave birth at the Khaleej-e-Fars Hospital in Bandar Abbas, Iran, between January 1, 2020, and January 1, 2022
finding: Machine learning models, particularly XGBoost classification, were a credible approach for improving postpartum hemorrhage prediction with high accuracy, identifying risk factors such as living residency, parity, cesarean delivery, education, and induced labor.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with an increased risk of postpartum hemorrhage, especially when general anesthesia was used.
